survey: An inflatable beach ball resting on sand, seen at an angle so that one pole faces the camera, slightly up and to the left. It has six gores that alternate colour and white: red, white, green, white, blue, white. Every seam runs to a round purple pole cap, and the gores widen evenly towards the equator in the right perspective. The silhouette is a clean sphere. The ball rests on the sand at a single low contact point, with a shadow cast below and to the left, so it is grounded. There is no visible inflation valve, which counts as an acceptable simplification.
